outcome: Sexual function (measured by the Female Sexual Function Index)
cohort: Postpartum women with (exposed, n=145) and without (non-exposed, n=187) severe maternal morbidity at two tertiary hospitals
finding: After adjusting for age and mental health, there was no significant difference in sexual function scores between women with and without severe maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: Women with severe maternal morbidity were more likely to have had a cesarean section than those without severe maternal morbidity.
